integrity: This is an original mathematical specialization and analysis of a published iteration, not a proof of a new rational-map dynamical phenomenon. Companion literature access and exhaustive historical priority remain incomplete.
scientific_limitations: One-node conforming P1 mesh, a forced algebraic Kirchhoff step at timestep 1, exact arithmetic, undamped Picard iteration. No contradiction of conditional small-step convergence and no energy claim for the forced approximate iterates.
title: A sharp forcing threshold for Picard two-cycles in a conforming Kirchhoff finite element step
